entity.summary: Self-custody Bitcoin and Stacks wallet ecosystem formerly branded Hiro Wallet, now distributed primarily as a browser extension and mobile application.
entity.notes: Hiro Wallet continuity is preserved as one entity. Leather Wallet LLC acquired the wallet assets from Hiro Systems and rebranded the wallet to Leather in 2023.

products.summary: Original desktop-wallet lineage launched in 2019 and later deprecated after Leather shifted users toward the browser extension.
products.notes: Leather announced in October 2025 that the desktop wallet would no longer receive updates or security fixes.

products.summary: Current Leather browser-extension wallet, continuing the extension lineage formerly branded Hiro Wallet.
products.notes: General browser-store availability is anchored to 2021-08-10 under the historical Hiro Wallet branding; the product later continued through the 2023 Leather rebrand. Current official URL points to Leather’s dedicated browser-extension product page.

products.summary: Leather mobile wallet released for iOS and Android in 2025.
products.notes: Modeled separately from the browser extension because distribution and device-security boundaries differ.

events.title: Leather Wallet LLC acquired Hiro Wallet assets
events.description: Leather Wallet LLC, a Trust Machines subsidiary, announced that it had acquired the wallet assets from Hiro Systems PBC while preserving the wallet lineage.

events.title: Hiro Wallet rebranded to Leather
events.description: The existing Hiro Wallet desktop and browser-extension lineage was rebranded to Leather as the wallet became an independent brand under Leather Wallet LLC.

events.title: Browser-extension cached secret-key vulnerability reported
events.description: Leather's security history records a browser-extension issue where browser textarea caching could leave a private key or mnemonic in local storage under certain conditions, creating exposure if another party gained access to the computer.
events.notes: Leather records the report on August 8, 2023 and resolution on August 10, 2023 in extension version 6.3.1.

events.title: Leather Mobile launched
events.description: Leather launched its mobile wallet application for iOS and Android.

events.title: Leather Desktop deprecated
events.description: Leather deprecated its desktop wallet and stated that it would no longer receive updates or security fixes, directing users toward the browser extension.

events.title: Hiro Wallet browser extension became available in Chrome and Firefox stores
events.description: Hiro announced general store availability of its wallet browser extension on 2021-08-10 for Chrome and Firefox. This browser-extension lineage was later acquired and rebranded to Leather in 2023.
events.notes: This launch event belongs to the current Leather Browser Extension lineage under its historical Hiro Wallet branding. Chrome/Firefox are historical launch-time distribution facts and do not replace the current-platform list.

evidence.notes: Primary announcement for Hiro Wallet -> Leather continuity, the Leather Wallet LLC/Trust Machines structure, and acquisition of Hiro wallet assets.

evidence.title: Leather Security
evidence.notes: Primary retrospective security record for the August 2023 cached-secret-key browser extension issue and version 6.3.1 resolution.

evidence.title: Leather Changelog
evidence.notes: Primary chronology for the September 1, 2025 mobile launch and October 3, 2025 desktop-wallet deprecation; also states the desktop lineage began in 2019.

evidence.notes: Primary deprecation announcement stating that desktop wallet updates and security fixes would end and users should migrate to the web extension.
